cell_kind: TEXT-ONLY PROPOSER / REFLECTOR -- form proof; the offline step validates and archives the sealed proposals
claim_boundary: No benefit, system-level, superiority, generalisation, held-out, confirmatory or paper-scale claim.
execution_profile: model-free-check (the offline step); bounded-discovery-probe (the two text-only flights)

stages.1_validate_and_curate: python -B scripts/flights/tfrl/tfrl_loop_driver.py --execute open --iter 1 --stage cell (validates the sealed typed candidates through speech_aware_evidence_acquisition.rails.tfrl_typed_proposer and curates the ACE deltas through speech_aware_evidence_acquisition.rails.tfrl_ace_material; reads only sealed receipts, no row gold and no utterance text)
stages.2_archive: the same step writes the candidate states through speech_aware_evidence_acquisition.analysis.sealed_credit.archive (write-once receipts under the loop package); no score is computed and nothing is selected here

what_is_not_here: No score, no paired read, no margins block and no admission: the column cells and the loop's close step read effects.
